full_judgment: 13. The next contention on behalf of the appellant is that the plaintiff''s suit falls under Article 142 of the Limitation Act and having onus was on the plaintiffs to prove possession within 12(twelve) years prior to the institution of the suit but the plaintiffs failed to discharge this onus and the lower appellate Court to decide this material point in reversing the decisions of the trial Court failed and the same is not a proper judgment of reversal.
